title: The person's own agent instructions
description: GET and PUT /api/v1/account/agent-instructions. The person's daemon reads and writes one fixed file in their home, ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md, as the person; no request names a path. A write is a compare-and-swap: it names the version it was based on, or asks to create the file only if it is absent. A version that no longer matches is refused with 409 file_changed and nothing is written; the browser merges and asks again. Creating the file also creates ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md with one import line when that file is absent; an existing Claude file is only read, never changed. Only plain UTF-8 text without CR or NUL characters is read or written. The reply after a write is the file as now read. Errors: 400 invalid_request, 403 cross_user_denied, 409 file_changed, 413 file_too_large, 415 file_unsupported (a link, a hard-linked or special file, or not such text), 503 instructions_unavailable. A 5xx or lost reply to a write is uncertain and is never retried automatically. No-store.

exists.description: Whether the instructions file exists. When false, version and modified are null and content is empty.

claude.description: What ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md says about the instructions, read only: imports names the file on an import line, own has instructions without that line, none means the file is absent, unknown that it could not be read safely.
